add_preassigned_to_ivf_index: add vectors to a Faiss IVF index using precomputed cluster assignments
search_preassigned_ivf_index: search a Faiss IVF index with predefined inverted list numbers to probe
range_search_preassigned_ivf_index: perform a range search on a Faiss IVF index with predefined list numbers
replace_ivf_quantizer: replace the quantizer of a Faiss IVF index with a new quantizer
permute_invlists: apply a permutation to the inverted lists and quantizer entries of a Faiss IVF index
